sample.Description: Sample index (0-based) of the trigger-code onset

duration.Description: Length of the trigger pulse on the Amp1-trigger channel

trigger_code.Description: Digital value of the Amp1-trigger channel during the pulse (physical value converted back with the EDF header scaling). The release does not document the code-to-stimulus mapping. Code 1 is by far the most frequent (about 80% of pulses), consistent with the standard. The stimulus files in stimuli/stimuli_ECoG_MMN are numbered 01standard_flat_yi5, 02deviant_cross_rise_yi2 and 03deviant_within_flat_yi8, which suggests codes 1/2/3 = standard / cross-category deviant / within-category deviant; this is an inference, not stated by the authors. Code 255 (all bits set) appears in a few runs and is not explained.
